method.admission_next: Further actual AI field-edit testing only if 4 distinct held groups gain a useful location and at most 2 ordinary held groups flag in either carrier. This authored experiment does not qualify any AI inference or app activation.
method.appearance: Continuous local contrast-normalized ink shape, optionally plus 0.35 times absolute log aspect mismatch. Analyze both frozen arms.
method.candidate: Same recognized digit in one OCR line, minimum four occurrences. Leave-one-out median distance against a mutually consistent triple; normalize each glyph to 20x28 and allow one normalized pixel for alignment. Require one qualifying consensus triple.
method.coords: The submitted raster in native pixels, exact difference before final carrier encode determines the changed mask.
method.limitations: Authored inventory-like screenshots; controls include an intended single-glyph emphasis that may be visually equivalent to a patch. No AI-generated input.
method.point: For each carrier and each arm use the second-highest of six ordinary-development group maxima. Strict exceedance, strongest glyph only, no use of held measurements.
method.useful: IoU >= 0.30 and recall >= 0.50 on all changed pixels. Only deliberately substituted glyphs count as positive.
